notes.title: Synced Actions, Conditions and Events
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32632973/611ddca6b89a1d210e39b62441303fc25fae3058.png[/img]

AGE has a powerful tool for scripting entire sequences across multiple editors using synchronized actions without writing a single line of code. This tool also allows you to set up the interactions of your game by intercepting events.

[url=https://www.seccia.com/age]seccia.com/age[/url]

[u]Object editor[/u]

- Pack texture size field added (64 to 2048)
- 4 colors palette mode added (useful for shadow animation)

[u]WebGL[/u]

- Crazygames build added

[u]Information about the new palette[/u]

When you use 4 colors, each pack texture is stored as 2 bits layer in one 32 bits texture. So the limit is 16 layers per texture.

You can customize 3 colors for each object. The last color is used for the transparency.

It works on all platforms.
